meta.name: Wildflower Wind
meta.author: Sunnyside
meta.essence: A meadow, seen through a pane of glass.
meta.promise: Everything you make with this looks gathered, not arranged.
meta.family: One glass petal, four times held, one time gone.
meta.oneSentence: Wildflower Wind is a seed house seen through glass: a haze ground, translucent panes with one lit edge, a violet that is the cosmos refracted, and a mark built from five petals where the overlap is the ink.

theme.family: constructed — a placement table, rendered in glass
theme.material: frosted glass over a meadow; one lit edge per surface
theme.edge: 1px of light on the top-left, nothing on the bottom-right
theme.offset: the taken petal sits 2.6 petal-lengths out, never closer
theme.stroke: no strokes — the rim is a highlight, not a line
theme.tile: rounded, never square; a glass chip is a lens, not a box
theme.ring: signal at 2px, 2px offset, plus a 1px white inner rim
theme.label: uppercase mono, 0.16em, always above the thing it names
theme.field-recipe: photograph, blurred and tinted, then a pane on top
theme.mark-form: five translucent petals; overlap multiplies to ink

primitives.name: haze
primitives.role: The air behind the pane. The page.

primitives.name: petal
primitives.role: Tint inside the glass. Never text.

primitives.name: signal
primitives.role: Cosmos, refracted. The one accent — ≤8% of a viewport.

primitives.name: gold
primitives.role: Low sun through the pane. Graphic only — fails as text.

primitives.name: sky
primitives.role: Daylight behind the glass. Surface only — fails as text.

darkPrimitives.name: haze
darkPrimitives.role: The field at dusk, behind the pane.

darkPrimitives.name: signal
darkPrimitives.role: The same refracted violet, lifted to hold contrast.

light.name: edge-lit
light.role: The lit edge of a pane

type.name: display-1
type.use: One per page. The name, or the idea.

type.name: label
type.use: Uppercase. Always above what it names.

type.name: figure
type.use: Tabular. Right-aligned. Never on a rule.

motion.name: drift
motion.use: Anything that moves on its own.

motion.name: settle
motion.use: Pane entrances. Once per page load.
